::: {#hero-heading}
I am a **postdoctoral researcher** at the Institute of Space and Earth Information Science ([ISEIS](https://www.iseis.cuhk.edu.hk/en/)), *The Chinese University of Hong Kong* ([CUHK](https://www.cuhk.edu.hk/)). I received my PhD in Geography from CUHK in July 2026, supervised by [Prof. Mei-Po Kwan](https://meipokwan.org/) and [Prof. Zihan Kan](https://www.zihankan.com/). I previously served as a research fellow at the Computational Social Science Laboratory ([CSSL\@CUHK](https://cssl.socsc.cuhk.edu.hk/)).

My research examines how **human mobility** shapes exposure to urban environments and its implications for **health and well-being**. I combine spatial data science, machine learning, and mobility-based approaches to study human–environment interactions. My research focuses on:

1.  How urban environments and daily mobility jointly shape environmental exposure and well-being.
2.  Applications of spatial data science and machine learning to understanding urban environments and human behavior.
3.  Spatial analysis and causal inference methods for studying human–environment interactions.
